name: ioi
description: IOI is a text-only benchmark that probes a model's ability to identify and reason about items' indices or referents in context, testing long-range attention, memorisation and positional reasoning. Tasks typically present sequences or passages and require the model to select the correct referent or index from choices. It is intended to stress in-context tracking and simple multi-step inference rather than broad world knowledge.
reputation: Used by researchers probing in-context memory and positional reasoning; moderately known in the evaluation research community but not a mainstream benchmark.
